info.name: Peach Payments API
info.description: Peach Payments provider — payment (DB), authorize (PA for cards, DB for non-card), capture (CP), refund (RF), void/reversal (RV), transaction status lookup, transaction logs, and webhook simulation. Covers all supported payment brands: VISA, MASTER, AMEX, DINERS, PAYBYBANK, PEACHEFT, NDBEFT, MASTERPASS, PAYSHAP, MOBICRED, RCSSTORECARDS, PAYFLEX, ZEROPAY, FLOAT, HAPPYPAY.

item.name: Peach – Payment Flow (POST /payment)
item.description: Debit (DB) payment flow via Hosted Checkout — initiates a redirect-based charge. Covers card brands and alternative payment methods.

exec: pm.test('inlineRedirect is iframe-ready', function () { pm.expect(json.inlineRedirect).to.include({ mode: 'IFRAME', method: 'GET' }); });

item.name: Peach – Authorize Flow (POST /authorise)
item.description: Pre-authorization flow — uses PA for card brands (hold funds without capture) and DB for non-card brands. Card brands require a subsequent capture to finalize.

exec: pm.test('inlineRedirect is iframe-ready', function () { pm.expect(json.inlineRedirect).to.include({ mode: 'IFRAME', method: 'GET' }); });

item.name: Peach – S2S 3DS Card Flow
item.description: Server-to-Server card payment flow with 3D Secure. Requires PCI-DSS compliance. Card details are sent directly in metadata. The response may include a 3DS redirect URL for challenge authentication.

request.description: S2S card payment with 3DS — sends card data directly. Uses test card 4111111111111111 which triggers 3DS. Response will include PENDING_3DS status with redirectUrl for the 3DS challenge page.
S2S card payment without 3DS — uses test card 4200000000000000 (Approved without 3DS). Gets synchronous success response.
S2S pre-authorization with 3DS challenge. Uses PA (pre-auth) for card hold. threeDSecure.challengeIndicator=04 forces a mandated challenge. After 3DS completion, use the capture endpoint to finalize.
S2S pre-authorization with Mastercard. Includes browser data for 3DS v2 risk assessment.

item.name: S2S STATUS – Get Payment by ID

request.description: After the 3DS challenge completes and the shopper is redirected back, query the payment status to get the final result. The providerReference from the original S2S request is used.

item.name: Peach – Operations
item.description: Capture (CP), Refund (RF), Void/Reversal (RV) — requires a valid paymentId from a previous payment or authorize call.

item.name: Peach – Status & Logs
item.description: Transaction status lookup, payment retrieval, transaction listing, and payment logs.

item.name: Peach – Webhook Simulation
item.description: Simulate a Peach checkout or payment result webhook callback. Update merchantTransactionId and result.code to test different states.
